content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To use sponge rollers, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Mist the set hair with a light-hold finishing spray (30 seconds)
Step 2. Wash hair with a moisturizing shampoo (10 minutes)
Step 3. Apply a small amount of smoothing serum to ends (1 minute)
Step 4. Divide hair into four major quadrants (4 minutes)
Step 5. Select the appropriate roller size for the nape area (1 minute)
Step 6. Detangle the crown section with a wide-tooth comb (2 minutes)
Step 7. Apply a dollop of setting mousse to the damp hair (2 minutes)
Step 8. Begin rolling the middle sections toward the scalp (15 minutes)
Step 9. Allow the hair to air dry completely (6 hours)
Step 10. Separate a one-inch sub-section of hair (30 seconds)
Step 11. Check the moisture level of the roots (30 seconds)
Step 12. Distribute the serum evenly using a fine-tooth comb (2 minutes)
Step 13. Deep condition the hair for extra elasticity (20 minutes)
Step 14. Towel dry hair until it is slightly damp (5 minutes)
Step 15. Plug in a hooded dryer for optional heat (1 minute)
Step 16. Secure the roller clip firmly in place (15 seconds)
Step 17. Wrap the ends of the hair around the sponge core (45 seconds)
Step 18. Position the roller horizontally against the head (10 seconds)
Step 19. Ensure the hair tension is even across the roller (20 seconds)
Step 20. Section off the fringe or bangs (3 minutes)
Step 21. Roll the side sections away from the face (10 minutes)
Step 22. Unroll the first test curl to check definition (1 minute)
Step 23. Prepare the rollers by removing any lint (2 minutes)
Step 24. Comb through each section to ensure it is smooth (8 minutes)
Step 25. Rinse hair with cool water to seal the cuticle (3 minutes)
Step 26. Repeat the rolling process for the back of the head (12 minutes)
Step 27. Apply a leave-in conditioner spray (2 minutes)
Step 28. Use a rat-tail comb to create clean parts (5 minutes)
Step 29. Gather all necessary hair styling tools (5 minutes)
Step 30. Wind the hair tightly around the foam cylinder (1 minute)
Step 31. Spray each section with a heat protectant (1 minute)
Step 32. Organize the sponge rollers by size (3 minutes)
Step 33. Shake out the curls with your fingers (2 minutes)
Step 34. Check that all rollers are comfortable for sleeping (2 minutes)
Step 35. Sit under the hooded dryer to accelerate the process (45 minutes)
Step 36. Smooth a setting lotion over the hair strand (1 minute)
Step 37. Remove the sponge rollers carefully (5 minutes)
Step 38. Fasten the plastic clasp over the roller (10 seconds)
Step 39. Brush the hair thoroughly to remove knots (4 minutes)
Step 40. Blow dry the hair on a low setting for a few minutes (10 minutes)
Step 41. Apply a shine-enhancing pomade (2 minutes)
Step 42. Lay out a silk scarf to protect the rollers (1 minute)
Step 43. Gently brush through the curls for a soft wave (5 minutes)
Step 44. Lightly dampen any dry spots with a water mister (2 minutes)
Step 45. Wait for the hair to set overnight (8 hours)
Step 46. Let the hair cool down from any applied heat (15 minutes)
Step 47. Cover the rollers with a silk bonnet (2 minutes)
Step 48. Check the mirror for any missed spots (1 minute)
Step 49. Clean the bathroom vanity area (5 minutes)
Step 50. Lightly fluff the roots for volume (2 minutes)
